 Today’s headlines: Bato dela Rosa, Paolo Duterte, Alex Eala 
 Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:
 DILG says Bato has 1 week to surrender, offers P50-M reward for arrest   
 The Department for the Interior and Local Government and the Philippine National Police set a deadline of one week for International Criminal Court suspect Senator Bato dela Rosa to surrender.
 Paolo Duterte files cyber libel complaint vs GMA Network over Gracioso report   
 Davao City 1st District Representative Paolo Duterte files a cyber libel complaint against officials and journalists of GMA Network.
 Red flags in 2027 agri budget: Coordinates at sea, ‘overpriced’ infra projects 
 Civil society group People’s Budget Coalition raises red flags during the Senate finance committee hearing on the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of Agriculture.
 Millions of hacking attempts as companies, governments rush to patch PHP flaws    
 Companies and governments worldwide rushed on Thursday, October 22, to patch critical flaws in the widely-used PHP programming language.
 Alex Eala bows out of Ningbo Open after loss vs Diana Shnaider 
 Alex Eala bows out of the Ningbo Open after conceding to sixth seed Diana Shnaider, 5-6, 4-6. – Rappler.com
